name: power_pd_trigger
title: HeyPCB PD Trigger - USB-C PD sink, DIP-selected 5/9/12/15/20 V at 3 A
brief: USB-C Power Delivery trigger: a HUSB238 negotiates a fixed voltage from any PD charger and closes a DMP3013SFV P-FET onto a screw terminal; a 4-way DIP switch selects 5, 9, 12 or 15 V (all off: 20 V), the request is 3.0 A; an SMBJ24A TVS and a green LED on the output; 28 x 40 mm, 2 layers.

blocks.title: HUSB238 PD sink, DIP voltage select, P-FET output switch

netClasses.name: PWR
netClasses.why: 0.5 mm enters the PowerDI3333's 0.4 mm source leads and the receptacle's VBUS pins; the 3 A path itself is carried in board.zones

rules.why_min_track: Freerouting may neck into a 0.5 mm-pitch DFN pin; JLCPCB 2-layer builds 0.127 mm

board.notes: 2 layers: F.Cu signal + GND pour, B.Cu signal + GND pour, both poured after routing.

zones.name: vbus
zones.why: the receptacle's four VBUS pins to the switch's source leads: up to 3 A

zones.name: vout
zones.why: the switch's drain pad to the terminal's + pin and the TVS: up to 3 A

usb:J?.why: plug seats with the shell 0.6 mm proud of the left edge, lower half, level with the output switch

out:J?.why: output wires leave the right edge, straight across from the receptacle

pd:Q?.why: output switch between the receptacle's VBUS pins and the terminal: source leads facing VBUS, drain pad facing the terminal

pd:U?.why: PD controller top-left, leaving the strip left of the DIP switch free for its voltage labels

pd:SW?.why: voltage DIP switch top-right, reachable with a fingertip

led:R?.why: output LED in the middle-left, below the DIP switch's labels

pd:R5?.why: GATE series resistor beside the switch it drives

switches.why: + at the terminal pin on VOUT, - at GND

captions.place_3d: USB-C on the left edge, the HUSB238 above the output switch, the voltage DIP switch below, the output terminal on the right edge.
captions.done_3d: HUSB238 PD sink, DIP-selected 5/9/12/15/20 V at 3 A, DMP3013SFV output switch, SMBJ24A TVS, output LED.
